name: Overgrown ruins
one_line: Mossy stone, hanging vines and dappled sunlight.
look_words: Old stone buildings that the forest has taken back. Warm grey stone with soft worn edges, moss and deep fresh greens over everything, vines and tree roots wrapped around arches and fallen columns, shallow clear pools. Sunlight comes down through leaves in dappled patches, so the ground is a pattern of light and shade. Gold marks what to collect, turquoise marks the goal, red is harm, and the player is pale cream against the green. Shapes are big blocks softened by plants. Motion is quiet: leaves shifting, light patches moving, birds, falling petals. It should feel safe and old, not threatening. Avoid dark jungle gloom, bright saturated greens, carved writing, skulls and bloom.
